svg.text: 900 seeds, dz/dt = −p/p′ for p = z³ − 1: 35.7% reach 1, 32.2% ω, 32.1% ω²
arg p is constant along every river, so the flow's basins are sectors cut by three
straight rays into 0 (35.6 / 32.2 / 32.2% of the square). Faint: discrete Newton
boundaries, 50.6 → 70.6 → 99.7 long as the grid doubles: fractal, on and off the rays.
